en.name: Focalors
en.ability: Evil knows you're in play, if evil publically guesses you (once), your team loses. If you executed & the game would end today or tonight, your team wins. You're an Archon.

revisions.v1: Evil knows you're in play, if evil publically guesses you (once), your team loses. If you executed & the game would end today or tonight, your team wins. You're an Archon.

en.flavor: Lies beget lies, and at the end of an endless web of deceit, we see "justice." The ignorant scoff, calling it all a farce. But he who traces the lie to its source will find that he himself was the first to be deceived.
en.firstNightReminder: Evil player learn Focalors are in-play.
